children: Malaysia's exports rose 45.5% year on year in August, higher than expectations, government data showed on Friday.
August exports had been expected to grow 37.9%, according to 14 economists surveyed by Reuters.
Imports in August grew 41.1% from a year earlier, data from the statistics department showed. Analysts were expecting a 33.2% increase.
Malaysia recorded a trade surplus of 28.1 billion ringgit ($6.89 billion) in August, compared to the poll forecast of 25 billion ringgit.
